name: MCMC Densification
definition: A Bayesian densification strategy that reformulates Gaussian Splatting densification as a Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamic (SGLD) update rule, adding noise to center locations.
summary: MCMC Densification treats 3D Gaussians as Markov Chain Monte Carlo samples, using stochastic gradient Langevin dynamics to adjust their distribution without heuristic cloning or splitting.
